items.title: Microsoft says virtually nobody was grabbing NYT articles through its chatbot
items.raw_excerpt: Microsoft's Copilot rarely reproduces even full sentences from news articles and books, let alone substantive chunks that could substitute for the original, the company says in new legal filings as it fights copyright claims from publishers including The New York Times and book authors. As part of the lawsuit's discovery, Microsoft provided 8.2 million Copilot […]

title_i18n.en: Microsoft says virtually nobody was grabbing NYT articles through its chatbot
title_i18n.zh: 微软表示，几乎没有人通过其聊天机器人抓取《纽约时报》的文章。
title_i18n.es: Microsoft afirma que prácticamente nadie estaba obteniendo artículos del NYT a través de su chatbot.

excerpt_i18n.en: Microsoft's Copilot rarely reproduces even full sentences from news articles and books, let alone substantive chunks that could substitute for the original, the company says in new legal filings as it fights copyright claims from publishers including The New York Times and book authors. As part of the lawsuit's discovery, Microsoft provided 8.2 million Copilot […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 微软在对抗版权侵权的新法律文件中表示，Copilot很少逐句复述新闻文章和书籍中的内容，更不用说能替代原作的大段实质内容了。
excerpt_i18n.es: El Copilot de Microsoft rara vez reproduce siquiera frases completas de artículos periodísticos y libros, y mucho menos fragmentos sustanciales que pudieran sustituir al original, afirma la empresa en nuevos escritos legales mientras se defiende de las demandas por derechos de autor.
